title: KMS rotation event synthesis and compliance reporting pipeline
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Build an end-to-end pipeline that ingests key lifecycle events from cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and on-prem HSM gateways, normalizes them into a canonical rotation event schema, correlates events with tenant data residency metadata, and produces signed evidence bundles for audit export. Bundles should capture: key ID/version, rotation timestamp, rotation type (automated/forced/manual), requester identity (service principal/CI user), residency/region attributes, associated resource lists (e.g., model artifacts/tenant datasets), retention policy snapshot, and a cryptographic manifest (hashes + signature). Outputs: (1) an immutable S3/GCS audit store for long-term retention, (2) a RESTful reporting endpoint for Console and SOC2 evidence exports, (3) a Console UI page summarizing recent rotations and any anomalous rotations flagged by rules. The pipeline must support configurable retention, retention evidence snapshots for a point-in-time, and automated alerting for missed rotations or HSM availability issues.
acceptance_criteria: Rotation events from AWS/GCP/Azure and on-prem HSMs are normalized into canonical schema within 30s of occurrence
Evidence bundles contain signer identity and digest anchored to a versioned audit store
Console exposes a per-tenant rotation timeline and a downloadable evidence bundle per rotation
Automated retention enforcement removes ephemeral evidence according to tenant policy while retaining required audit snapshots
Integration tests that replay synthetic rotation events validate correlation and bundle creation with >=95% fidelity
work_items: Design canonical rotation-event schema and version it (proto/json schema)
Implement KMS connectors: AWS KMS CloudTrail adapter, GCP audit log adapter, Azure activity log adapter
Build HSM gateway forwarder for on-prem appliances (TLS+mutual auth)
Evidence bundler service: assemble manifest, compute digests, attach signatures (KMS signing or HSM-backed key)
Retention controller: snapshot policy enforcer and purge worker
Console page: rotation timeline, filters by tenant/region/type, download button
E2E tests: synthetic event replays and integrity checks
Runbook and incident playbook for missed rotations / HSM outages
